jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: registered native-scale top-down terrain patch for a survival game. Image 1 is the exact edit target and road-layout guide. Image 2 is the APPROVED reference for integrated road-and-soil artwork, not a layout to copy.
Redesign only the faulty generic road extension and its immediate earth shoulders in image 1. Keep the original camp road portion in its exact position. Follow the road centreline in image 1 precisely, including bends. Join the original path cleanly, replacing ghosted/double stones with single solid stones. Match the original camp artwork and image 2: crisp hand-painted irregular warm-grey and tan cobbles, richer brown soil between stones, varied angular rounded shapes and subtle bevels. Individual main stones about 25–48 image pixels throughout, never shrink them as the path narrows; use fewer stones across narrow stretches. Paint road and soil together with irregular worn shoulders, occasional whole loose fragments and natural earth contact shading. No repeated bead motif, stretched ovals, blur, translucent stones or hard rectangular terrain seams.
Preserve all ground beyond the immediate road corridor, the palette and texture scale, the exact frame and size of image 1. Keep the outer 80 pixels unchanged except repairing a ghosted road where necessary. No new foliage, grass, green tint, leaves, puddles, structures, props, text or UI. Full opaque artwork.
